# `matter/runtime/MatterRuntimeCoordinator.js`

> **Source:** `engine/matter/runtime/MatterRuntimeCoordinator.js`

Deterministic frame orchestration, diagnostics, replay, and device recreation for Matter.

## Classes

### `class MatterFramePipeline`

Records the canonical seventeen-stage Matter frame into a caller-owned encoder. A failed stage marks the encoder unusable; the caller must discard it instead of submitting.
